statement: An eligible officer (a director of a company registered under the Corporations Act) must have a director identification number; the requirement is deferred only while an application made before the person first became an eligible officer, within a regulation-specified period, or within a longer period the Registrar allows, remains undetermined.
caveat: Contravention is a strict-liability offence and a civil penalty provision. Director IDs are issued by the Registrar through Australian Business Registry Services (abrs.gov.au, bot-walled at check time); new directors of Corporations Act companies must apply before appointment under the current application directions.
reviewer: Starter editorial review; independent domain expert review pending
